sources_chirho.license_chirho: CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), dedicated by Global Bible Tools itself. Only English New Testament glosses (Alan Bunning, CNTR) are "used with permission"; this is an Old Testament file, GBT's own export at the recorded commit.
